newsitem.title: USA: American Airlines, Eagle to cut summer fares.
newsitem.headline: American Airlines, Eagle to cut summer fares.

text.p: AMR Corp's American Airlines and American Eagle said on Thursday that they will offer 45 percent fare cuts during off-peak summer periods on domestic flights.

The fares will average 45 percent off the regular 21-day advance purchase fares, but will require only a seven-day advance purchase, the companies said. Tickets must be bought by June 16 for flights through the end of October.
In addition, the airlines said they will offer special prices on flights to Mexico, Russia, Brussels and St. Croix in the Caribbean.
